items.title: St. Regis to enter Bengaluru with 397-room luxury hotel in October 2027
items.why: India's luxury hotel pipeline is growing; track St. Regis for future hotel-credit partnership talks.
items.summary_ai: Marriott's St. Regis brand plans a 397-room luxury hotel in Bengaluru, slated to open in October 2027.
items.take: India's luxury hotel pipeline is growing; track St. Regis for future hotel-credit partnership talks.
